opportunities.name: Country macro snapshot emailed from World Bank + Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a given country, look up it on World Bank Open Data (GDP, growth, population), look up capital/currency on Wikipedia, then draft an email '<Country> macro snapshot' to a recipient with the summary and discard the draft.
steps: Open World Bank Open Data and type the country name in the search box, press Enter
Read population/indicators on the country page
Open Wikipedia and search the country name, press Enter to read capital and currency
Open mail compose and enter recipient in To
Enter body with GDP, growth, population, capital and currency

opportunities.name: Book reading note from Gutenberg + Wikipedia author lookup
opportunities.description: Search a book title on Project Gutenberg, open the top result, look up the author on Wikipedia, and add a note 'Read: <title> by <author> (years), Gutenberg since <date>, <downloads> downloads' in Notes.
steps: Type book title in Gutenberg search and press Enter
Click the top result to read release date and downloads
Open Wikipedia and search the author name, press Enter to get life years
Open Notes app and click New note
Type 'Read: <title> by <author> (<years>), Gutenberg since <release date>, <downloads> downloads'
